description: This file defines a static class 'AssetCopyFlows' responsible for orchestrating the end-to-end workflow for copying assets within the system. It includes data structures for request and response wrappers, and a key method 'CopyAssetAsync' which handles copying an asset, related records, and maintaining lineage, with logging and error handling.

classes.name: AssetCopyFlows
classes.description: Contains static methods and records related to the asset copy process, including the main 'CopyAssetAsync' method.

classes.name: CopyAssetFlowRequest
classes.description: Record wrapping parameters for the copy asset flow: source asset ID and request details.

classes.name: CopyAssetFlowResponse
classes.description: Record wrapping the copy asset response details.

methods.name: CopyAssetAsync
methods.description: Main asynchronous method to handle copying an asset, including logging, validation, repository interaction, and return of response.
